<div class="card-body">
'''Panic''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">パニック</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">相手が２倍以上の合計戦闘力を持っている位置カードで、相手が戦闘を宣言したら、直後に使用する。君のリザーブデッキから最大で３枚のカードを引ける。引いたカードがキャラクター、宇宙船、ビークル、武器のいずれかであれば、どこに配備してもよい（コスト不要）。その他のカードならロストデッキへ。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-103o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">帝国軍兵士によって追いつめられた時、ハンのギャンブラーならではの条件反射が働いた。先手必勝だ！こっちから急襲すれば、不意をつける……かもしれない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Panic.

'''Card text:''' Use immediately after the opponent initiates a battle at a site where the opponent has at least double your total power. Draw up to 3 cards from your Reserve Deck. Deploy any of those that are characters, starships, vehicles, or weapons anywhere for free. The rest go to the Lost Pile.

'''Lore:''' Cornered by Imperial troops, Han's gambler reflexes kicked in. Strike first! A sudden attack might catch them off guard.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese may deploy characters, starships, vehicles, or weapons; the English also allows devices.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Panic]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
